audit_items.title: Verify EIP-7702 Authorizer Authentication: Can an attacker forge authorization to impersonate the actor-eip7702-authorizer?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature related to transaction authorization and account code delegation. The target codebase is Prysm, which is a consensus layer (CL) implementation. EIP-7702 authorization validation logic would only exist in execution layer clients (Geth, Nethermind, Besu, etc.), not in consensus layer clients.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 transaction processing occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-006: Is the ECDSA signature s-value validated to be in the lower half of secp256k1 curve order?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. The s-value malleability check for EIP-7702 Authorization tuples would be implemented in execution layer clients, not in consensus layer clients like Prysm.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 signature validation occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Does signature malleability in EIP-7702 Authorization allow recovery to an unintended address?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. Signature malleability checks for EIP-7702 Authorization tuples are handled by execution layer transaction validation, not by consensus layer clients.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 authorization processing occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does the EIP-7702 authorization validation correctly reject ecrecover results returning address(0)?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. The ecrecover validation for EIP-7702 Authorization tuples is performed during execution layer transaction processing, not in consensus layer clients.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 ecrecover validation occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Is the transaction sender validation robust against address(0) authorization attacks at the P2P boundary?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. The P2P transaction validation for EIP-7702 occurs in the execution layer's transaction pool and mempool logic, not in consensus layer clients.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 P2P transaction validation occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the EIP-7702 Authorization chain_id field validated against the current chain ID?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. The chain_id validation for EIP-7702 Authorization tuples is part of execution layer transaction validation logic, not consensus layer processing.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 chain_id validation occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Does the EIP-7702 Authorizer actor enforce chain_id binding before signing delegation authorizations?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. The Authorizer actor and chain_id binding enforcement for EIP-7702 are part of execution layer transaction handling, not consensus layer functionality.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 authorization signing occurs in the execution layer or user wallets.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-006: Is EIP-7702 Authorization nonce validation correctly enforced?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. The nonce validation for EIP-7702 Authorization tuples is performed in execution layer transaction processing, not in consensus layer clients.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 nonce validation occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Can an attacker replay an EIP-7702 Authorization after the authorizer's nonce has incremented?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. Replay protection via nonce checking for EIP-7702 is implemented in execution layer transaction validation, not in consensus layer clients.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 replay protection occurs in the execution layer.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-006: Is the authorizer's nonce incremented after successful EIP-7702 authorization processing?
audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 is an execution layer (EL) feature. The nonce increment logic for EIP-7702 authorization is part of execution layer state transition functions, not consensus layer processing.
audit_items.notes: Prysm is a consensus layer client. EIP-7702 state transitions occur in the execution layer.
